method: Read the whole saved report and compared implementation, test, and limitation statements with current source and command output; applied protocols/writing-naturalness.md.

confidence_reason: I reviewed the complete draft against the exact implementation and test output. The score is an editorial judgment, and the technical review covers only this narrow candidate route.
